title: Refactor Hook Architecture Inlet-Outlet Adapter
description: Refactor the hook architecture to use inlet adapter -> neutral implementation -> outlet adapter pattern. CLI should accept native client events (VSCode PreToolUse, Windsurf pre_read_code, etc.) and resolve them to neutral events based on client + stdin context. The native configs should fire native events, not neutral events.
summary: Added HookAgentToolSearched (agent.tool.searching.ended) event for post-tool-use of search tools. resolvePostToolUse now returns HookAgentToolSearched for ToolKindCodeSearch. Added HookResultAgentToolSearched struct, RunHook case, trackHookInOpenTicket case, and updated windsurf post_read_code resolver. All test expectations updated.
